header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH, CIRCUIT COURT, MIRPURKHAS
(Mst. Syeda Muniba Naqvi v/s. P.O Sindh & Ors)
Petitioner: Through Mr. Sandeep Kumar Maheshwari, Advocate
body: 2. Through instant Petition, the Petitioner has claimed appointment against deceased quota available under Rule 11 - A of the Sindh Civil Servants (Appointment, Promotion & Transfer) Rule, 1974 (APT Rules).

3. It is the case of the Petitioner that her father was employed in School Education Department Government of Sindh and died while in service in year 2008. Petitioner at the time of death of her father was minor, however on attaining majority, she approached the Respondents to consider her case for appointment but to no avail. Learned Counsel therefore prays for appropriate directions.

4. Learned Additional Advocate General, present in Court in other matters waives notice and on perusal of case file states that Petitioner was required to approach the department within two years time from the death of his father, but she applied late. He therefore prayed for dismissal of the petition.

5. It reflected from the record that Petitioner’s father Nazeer Ahmed passed away in year 2008 and at that time age of the petitioner was 06 years. He attained majority on 08.08.2017, and she applied for the post in year 2017 as such her request is found within time.

6. It further transpired from record that Government of Sindh has constituted a committee to consider the cases of children of deceased employees in terms of Rule 11-A of APT Rules. In view of above, this petition is disposed of. The Respondents are directed to place the case of Petitioner before the departmental scrutiny committee and decide the same within a period of 3 months’ time from date of this order.
7. Office is directed to send copy of this Order to the Respondents for compliance.
